notes.title: Final Update is Here!
notes.content:
Hello, hoomans!

It's here! ːcathspawː Enjoy the release of the final update for A Castle Full of Cats! This bonus stage brings a fitting close to this chapter of A Castle Full of Cats. 

Enter the Castle one last time for a purrfect ending to this meowgical adventure. 💜

We also added four new achievments to the game, 2 for this update and 2 for the last one.

Thank you for all your love and support throughout this journey. We really appreciate it! ːlovecatː

If you enjoyed A Castle Full of Cats, you'll love A Tower Full of Cats, released just a few weeks ago. It follows the same system of finding cats and items, but on a much grander adventure. ːfofinoː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179170/A_Tower_Full_of_Cats/

And finally, we have a special gift for you: Stray Cats in Cozy Town, a free hidden object game coming soon! ːfofino2ː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2901140/Stray_Cats_in_Cozy_Town/

Stay tuned for more exciting news and adventures!

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•⩊•^ฅ

notes.title: Final Update is Coming!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans!

We want to thank you all for the love our latest update has received! We're purring with joy at your comments and warm reception! ːstareyescatː

This has made us believe it's time to tease another upcoming update for A Castle Full of Cats, one that will bring the game to its final version, completing this part of Lily's and Fofiño's saga.

So get ready for the purrfect finale! ːfofinoː We won't reveal much right meow, but we're adding something our community has been asking for since the game's release!

We'd also like to disclose that, with so many new features added since the game's release, we've had to make a decision about pricing. After 1st of May, A Castle Full of Cats will cost $3.99. This change won't affect anyone who already owns the game or those who purchase it before the price adjustment. And, of course, everyone who owns the game by the time the update rolls out will be able to play it without additional cost. ːkleinesː

https://i.imgur.com/RDeG13H.png

Don't miss out on the conclusion of this feline adventure! Stay tuned for the update and continue your journey with Lilly and Fofiño in A Castle Full of Cats.

Love and purrs,
The Devcats

notes.title: FREE GAME: An Arcade Full of Cats
notes.content:
FREE GAME ALERT! 

Attention, humans!

Introducing "An Arcade Full of Cats," our latest creation! Follow the link below to embark on a purrfect adventure and wishlist the game to spread the feline word far and wide! ːfofinoː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368470/An_Arcade_Full_of_Cats/

Step into the golden age of arcades alongside Fofiño and Leo, as they venture through this cat-tastic journey. Our mission is to transform Leo into a true Devcat, and rewrite history to give cats the glory they truly deserve! ːfofino2ː

The game will be about the same size as "A Building Full of Cats" and, like always, there"ll be some surprises along the way. 

Rest assured, this game won't delay the launch of "A Tower Full of Cats," as its artwork is already complete. Exciting news about "Tower" are coming soon, so stay tuned!


Cat Awareness Sale on August 8 

https://i.imgur.com/Fjove8U.png

Mark your calendars for a special event on August 8th – International Cat Day! This meaningful day, established in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, serves to raise awareness about cats and ways to protect and support them. ːcathspawː

Here at DEVCATS, we're deeply committed to cat advocacy and promoting feline adoption through our games. To honor our furry friends, we've prepared an incredible sale on Steam, uniting many PAWSOME participants who share the love for cats in all their forms and styles.

Help us make a difference and celebrate the greatness of cats together! Let's create a brighter future for our feline companions.  ːwinkycatː

See you soon!

Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Arcade Mode Update
notes.content:
Hi humans!

Arcade update is up and a lot have changed:

• There are new images for the arcade poster (title screen and coffin), and also a popup when you find the poster.

• As a lot of you have requested, there's no penalty on Fofiño's fight anymore. Now padlocks will not lock back if you fail to find all 4 cats in the screen. ːfofinoː

• One trick people were using while playing Arcade mode was to take a screenshot and pause the game. Because of this we've changed the way the arcade works. Now if you pause the game, all 4 cats will change positions, and even if you already find some of them, they'll be reset.
This is not ideal but it's better than the old method.

• Steam Leaderboards were reset. The old leaderbords will remain available on Steam.

That's it fur now.
Check the Arcade out to see the changes! ːkisscatː

One last thing: in case you've missed, the demo for A Tower Full of Cats is available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179170/A_Tower_Full_of_Cats/
Love & purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hello, humans!

A Castle Full of Cats launched a week ago and we are very happy with the results so far! ːfofino2ː
We have been working all the week long on solving small problems and making quality of life changes suggested by you.

Patch notes:

 Changed the "back" navigation arrows
 The zoom now follows the cursor
 Fixed the mouse lag
 It's now possible to click and drag on a door without entering it
 Tweaked some things on Fofiño's fight to make it more forgiving
 Removed the most difficult cats from Fofiño's fight
 The hint system now zooms in
 Hint particles last longer now
 Almost all rooms were optimized
 Changed the way the game renders some bigger maps
 Fixed some size limits for making the game working on older GPUs
 New SFX for Fofiño's door
 New SFX for the kittens
 Fixed Catchulhu's sign showing the text always in English
 It's now possible to exit the map by clicking out the map
 New coordinate/zoom when entering some rooms
 Changed the Credits tab
 Fixed some typos
 Fixed achievements not triggering when playing offline
 A lot of minor changes that we forgot already ^^


Now on to what really matters!!!
Yesterday was Fofiño's birthday!!!
9 years old of pure joy and shenaningans! ːfofinoː

https://i.imgur.com/QVojlSp.jpg

That's it fur now!
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Devlog: Entering the castle
notes.content:
Hello, humans!

It's been almost a week since ACFOC demo's launch and we are very happy with the results so far! ːlovecatː
Watching your videos playing our demo was very helpful to us: we have already made some changes on the counter and doors, and we're also changing the dialog box and tutorial.

Furthermore, this game is going to be much bigger than A Building Full of Cats.
Here is a comparison:

https://i.imgur.com/IkRMnDA.gif

Not only that, but also the rooms have much more details now. You will indeed need that zoom. ːwadacatː

The demo starts on the main hall but the full game starts outside the castle. We chose the hall because it's better at showing how the game structure looks. 

Another thing that was left out the demo was the map and its extra items (keys and relics). You can play the game just looking for the cats on each room and move on, but there will be some side missions to solve, in case you have a good heart and wish to help other cats on your way. ːwinkycatː

RELEASE DATE

https://i.imgur.com/FnggV6s.png

The original plan was October 24th, a day before the Steam Scream festival, to celebrate Halloween.
However,  we were not accepted in the festival... ːfofinoː
So we decided to move the release date to November 2nd. This will also give us extra time to polish the game.

Anyway, that's it for meow.
See you soon, humans!
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New plans
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/df0e4fb51833ef21830e865595720dbcad8b39c3.png
Hi, lovely humans!

Today is the most special day of all the year: International Cat Day!
"It was created in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, to raise awareness for cats and learn about ways to help and protect them" -- and that's what we've been doing (and will continue to do) in all of our current and future games: showing you humans that cats are just as cute and loving as dogs and we cats need care, love and protection just like them. ːfofino2ː

Now to the mews!
Here are some of the news about our games:

A BUILDING FULL OF CATS
Trading Cards and emoticons are here! ːlovecatː
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/80d862d45067ef3071c257cd96d5cff155d67a52.png
The hint system is coming in a few days. This next update will also include a Dutch localization.

CATS LOVE BOXES
We had plans for releasing Cats Love Boxes this month. We really believe in this game but the wishlists are WAY bellow than our other games. ːsweatcatː
That's crazy of you, humans... It's a game about BOXES! How can someone not be excited about that? ːcrycat2ː
Because of that, we postponed Cats Love Boxes launch to the end of the year.

COZY ROOM
That's the game we're willing to launch next. We don't have a release date yet but we hope to launch it in September.

A CASTLE FULL OF CATS
A Castle Full of Cats development is going well and we believe it will be a worthy successor to A Building Full of Cats. ːwinkycatː
A demo will be available on the October edition of Next Fest, so you can play the game before buying it.

SUDOCATS
There is going to be a small content update later this month, which will also include 2 new languages: Japanese and Russian.

Well, that's it! Enjoy your cats and cats games today most of all days, in homage to all feline friends in the world!
Thank you again, humans! ❤️
Love & Purrs,
Devcats
